backtest.text: Backtest (run in 2013–2019 on every filer's data as of then, 2,274 outcomes): the 80% range of revenue three years out held 81% of what happened (10% fell below it, 10% above) — about right. The chance of an operating profit within three years scores +0.02 against simply using the share that got there (Brier skill: above 0 is better than that base rate).
